newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Bruton announces 800 jobs boost for Shannon region.
newsitem.headline: Bruton announces 800 jobs boost for Shannon region.

text.p: Enterprise and Employment Minister Richard Bruton announced on Wednesday that 27 companies in the Shannon Development region are to create more than 800 jobs within three years.

"This is real proof that indigenous industry in the Shannon region is in excellent shape. Eighteen new and expanding countries will generate exciting employment opportunities right through the region," he said.
Irish companies are creating 494 jobs in Limerick, Clare, Offaly, Kerry and Tipperary.
In addition nine international companies will provide 310 jobs at the Shannon Free Zone in eight new projects and one expansion project, he said.
The new jobs are spread over a very wide range of industrial sectors with assitance from European Union grants.
